title: Endomorphisms of the 2-adic ring $C^*$-algebra and its Weyl group
summary: In this paper, we establish a one-to-one correspondence between a natural monoid and the endomorphisms of the $2$-adic ring $C^*$-algebra $\mathcal{Q}_2$. As a consequence, we classify endomorphisms of $\mathcal{Q}_2$ with prescribed images and derive several criteria for the uniqueness of extensions of endomorphisms of a canonical copy of the Cuntz algebra $\mathcal{O}_2$ inside $\mathcal{Q}_2$ to endomorphisms of $\mathcal{Q}_2$.
